 We are looking for an experienced Java Architect to lead the architecture, design, and development of Fable Fintech's cross-border payment platforms, covering remittances, foreign exchange (FX), payout orchestration, and settlement systems. 
 The role involves designing scalable, secure, and high-performance payment applications using Java based technologies, microservices, and distributed systems. The candidate will be responsible for building configurable, white-label payment solutions for banks, money transfer operators, and financial institutions. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, REST APIs, event-driven systems, and payment processing platforms. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 1. Application Architecture & Design Lead the architecture and design of scalable, high-performance Java-based applications. Design and implement microservices-based architectures for payment processing systems. Define application architecture, technology standards, design patterns, and technical roadmaps. Drive architectural reviews, technical documentation, and migration from legacy systems.

Strong experience in React.js for developing responsive and interactive frontend applications. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs between React.js frontend and Java-based backend services. Implement asynchronous processing, messaging, and distributed transaction management. Ensure application scalability, performance, maintainability, and code quality.

 5. Security, Compliance & Risk Management Integrate KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and fraud detection mechanisms into payment workflows. Ensure secure API communication, authentication, authorisation, and data encryption. Maintain compliance with relevant financial services security and regulatory requirements. Support PCI DSS, SOC 2, and data residency requirements.

Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making. Improve testing strategies, application observability, and production stability. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Java development, software architecture, or enterprise application development. Strong hands-on expertise in Java (Java 8/11/17 or later). Excellent knowledge of Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Spring Cloud. Strong experience in microservices architecture and distributed systems. Working experience with React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Experience in frontend and backend integration using REST APIs. Expertise in Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ. Strong database knowledge, including SQL and NoSQL. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud deployments. Understanding of application security and performance optimisation 
 Preferred Experience Experience in Banking, Fintech & Payments Exposure to cross-border payment platforms and transaction processing systems. Experience managing infrastructure for regulated financial environments. Strong stakeholder management and technical leadership capabilities.
